note: Starter packs. Ids are catalogue ids: curse-<CurseForge id> for addons in instawow's list, else an entry in `extra` (pack addons that aren't on CurseForge). `about` gives pack addons from instawow's list (which has no descriptions) a one-line description.

about.curse-942432: Modern one-bag inventory with categories. Good Baganator/Bagnon substitute.
about.curse-3358: Boss mods: warnings, timers and range checks (core).
about.curse-6273: Catches Lua errors so they don't spam you. Pairs with !BugGrabber.
about.curse-646135: Quality-of-life improvements across the default UI.
about.curse-486246: Levelling guides with an on-screen step tracker.
about.curse-324944: Shows trainable spells. Forever build is CurseForge / GitHub pre-release only for now.
about.curse-100547: Customisable nameplates with scripting and mods.
about.curse-1510306: Loot roll helper built for Forever.
about.curse-1160664: Remember players you've grouped with, good or bad.
about.curse-646134: Move and scale any default UI frame.
about.curse-1454793: Search anything in the UI: settings, spells, items, guides.
about.curse-962128: One click to equip the best gear in your bags.
about.curse-940950: Tweaks for the default unit frames.
about.curse-22067: See what all your characters have in their bags and banks.
about.curse-13494: Sort and stack your bags and bank.
about.curse-838806: Frees bag space by selling/destroying junk.

extra.name: DBM Dungeons
extra.desc: DBM dungeon modules for every expansion, including Forever.

extra.name: DBM Vanilla Raids
extra.desc: DBM raid modules for the classic-era raids.

extra.name: !BugGrabber
extra.desc: Catches Lua errors quietly. BugSack needs it.

extra.name: AutoSpellRanks
extra.desc: Keeps the highest spell rank on your bars.

extra.name: Edit Mode Expanded
extra.desc: More frames movable in Blizzard's Edit Mode.

extra.name: CanOpener
extra.desc: Opens lockboxes and containers for you.

extra.name: Prat 3.0
extra.desc: The standard chat addon: timestamps, colours, history, copy.

bundles.name: A good start
bundles.desc: What most people end up wanting, if you only grab one pack.
bundles.note: Boss warnings are three parts (DBM core, dungeons, vanilla raids). BugSack wants !BugGrabber, which needs a free Wago key.

bundles.name: Levelling
bundles.desc: Guides, training, nicer quest text and rare-mob alerts.
bundles.note: Questie isn't out for Forever yet; the built-in quest tracker works fine meanwhile.

bundles.name: Dungeons and raids
bundles.desc: Boss timers, nameplates and group helpers.
bundles.note: DBM rather than BigWigs for now: BigWigs' boss modules don't have Forever builds yet, so it would install empty.

bundles.name: Quality of life
bundles.desc: Small fixes to the default interface you stop noticing after a day.

bundles.name: Bags and inventory
bundles.desc: One bag, sorted, and what your other characters are carrying.
bundles.note: Bagnon and Baganator are CurseForge-only, so they aren't in the list; BetterBags does the same job.

bundles.name: Chat and social
bundles.desc: Better chat, translation, and notes on people you meet.
